prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story carousel onboarding intro: Redesign the initial story screen into an interactive carousel layout highlighting key companion features before path choice.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "body": "Swipe through to see how your pet hangs out, helps you focus, and reacts on your screen."}}
1: [home, redesign] Stage layout waiting experience: Redesign the asset generation waiting screen into a stage layout with time estimates and desktop notification options.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life", "body": "We are generating your pet's animations and custom traits. You can safely minimize this window."}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet trait preview sub-flow: Insert a new companion traits sub-flow before photo upload to clarify pet behavior options and reduce generation failures.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "new_trait_preview_flow", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Pick Your Companion Archetype"}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop display controls onboarding screen: Add a dedicated desktop controls overview screen before completing onboarding explaining how to minimize, show, or summon the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro", "new_desktop_controls_screen"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Ready to Launch Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Learn how your pet lives on your screen and where to find your system tray controls."}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account pet recovery explicit hint: Add an explicit account sync hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in preserves their adopted pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in links your adopted pet safely to your account so you never lose your companion.", "body": "Sign in to save your pet progress and sync seamlessly across devices."}}
5: [adoption, layout] Spotlight adoption seal ceremony: Update the adoption certificate layout to spotlight mode with an added official seal badge to increase sense of completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Verified Companion Adoption", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop interaction tip carousel during wait: Add a tip carousel component to the waiting screen that cycles desktop interaction tips every 10 seconds.
   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 10, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Quick Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open quick actions or put them to sleep.", "style": "calm"}]}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Photo lighting photo upload hint: Add photo quality guidance and instant preset callouts on the photo upload screen to prevent generation bugs.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best custom pet results, choose a clear, well-lit photo or tap to pick instant pre-made styles.", "body": "Upload your photo to generate your unique desktop friend."}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Step counter path selection list: Change path choice screen layout to list style and display explicit step counters to give clear onboarding direction.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "list", "show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Select Your Adoption Journey"}}
9: [finish, notification] System tray launch hint on finish: Add explicit system tray action guidance and a prominent launch button label on the home intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"button_label": "Summon Pet to Desktop Now", "hint": "If your pet doesn't appear immediately on screen, check your system tray in the taskbar.", "layout": "centered"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns story screen into a carousel while preserving its function of introducing the pet.
Redesigns waiting screen with stage layout and time estimates while clearly showing the pet is being generated.
Inserts a new trait preview sub-flow while preserving all required onboarding steps.
Adds a new desktop controls overview screen following home intro, which is permitted within onboarding.
Adds reassuring sign-in hint text without altering screen function or violating pricing/fair design rules.
Replaces the required official stamp on the adoption certificate with a playful badge, losing the official stamp representation.
Adds a tip carousel component to the waiting screen without disrupting its primary function.
Adds photo guidance hints to the photo upload screen without violating onboarding or copy rules.
Updates choose path layout and headline while retaining path selection functionality.
Updates home intro button label and system tray hint within onboarding boundaries.
